entries.rationale: Pinned ^0.5.1 resolves to 0.5.3; its claim handed out a warm pool entry whose directory was deleted outside the pool, running git with a missing cwd -> 'spawnSync git ENOENT' (hit during imboard #4164 setup, reproduced on 0.5.3 and 0.7.1). Fixed in worktree-pool 0.7.2 (ai-dossier#767); a 0.x caret range never leaves its minor, so the pin must move explicitly.

entries.anchor: ## Phase 3.25: Choose the Ship Mode — can this repo merge a parked PR?
entries.rationale: ai-dossier#860: the 2026-09-25 fleet dispatched every run detached into ai-dossier, which has no auto-merge watcher and no native auto-merge, so parked PRs would never merge. Plan time now detects the mechanism and defaults ship_mode=attached without one; every mode requires the full review round before merge (#795 / PR #837).

ai-dossier#860 follow-up: lessons proven in the 2026-09 fleets — reviewer hand-back transcripts under ~/.claude/projects/<proj>/<session>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl, refs/stash shared across worktrees, npm version re-check right before merge.
